text.name: IPCC Report and Nobel 2007
text.rules: Record "climate consensus". At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point, then SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: The IPCC's Fourth Assessment Report in 2007 called warming unequivocal and very likely human-caused; the panel shared the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize, announced on 12 October 2007.
